about: M11 review stills and checks (brief 7.3 M11 and the M11 review of November 11). Each group is one capture.mjs run on m11-controller-map.html: node mockups/tools/capture.mjs m11-controller-map.html <devices> <outDir> --states "<name>:<query>;..." built from the group's states, with --full when the group says so. Keys starting with @ are capture actions (README, Capture). A --full capture holds every frame and sheet section; with clean=1 each frame is one viewport tall, so it can be cut per frame. A viewport capture shows frame 1 (CONTROLLER MAP: PLAY), the frame the presses act on; each press state waits 400 ms at the end so the focus motion has finished before the still.
checks: Every 4.2 row appears once in each context; no action twice on one button (brief 7.3 M11 accept).
No button outside 4.1's set: no paddles, M1/M2, gyro or stick clicks (brief 7.3 M11 accept).
The map changes when a binding changes: USE sits on RT after interact=RT, and A joins NOT USED HERE (brief 7.3 M11 accept).

D-pad right and the right arrow move frame 1 from PLAY to DIALOGUE; D-pad left and the left arrow move it to CREDITS, wrapping (4.1: every screen works with the D-pad plus A and B). Needs the shared selector fix.
A click on the selector or on CONTEXT shows the next context.
At TEXT SIZE 200% on the Ally and the desktop: no callout outside .wo-padmap, no two callouts overlapping, nothing past the safe rect (4.4, XAG101). Needs the shared stacked layout.
On the iPhone with a pad: no element of the map view past the safe rect. Needs the shared phone layout.
The tab bar fits at the Ally's 125%; at 200% it scrolls and the selected tab stays whole in view, never under LB or RB. Needs the shared tab size.
No .is-focus in the markup; no focus ring with mouse or touch input, and none on a desktop frame before the first key or pad press.
A clash shows words (ALSO ON <action>) as well as colour. Needs the shared renderer change.
Smallest text on a 1920 x 1080 capture is the Body size or more; glyph letters are Body size.
